entities.name: René Lasserre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix "René" Lasserre was a French rugby union player who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was born in Bayonne and died in Saint-Avold. In 1924 he won the silver medal as member of the French team.
